_about: A tiny, deliberately vulnerable project used only to measure what the gate finds. It is stored as JSON so that this repository's own scans and GitHub code scanning do not report it. benchmark/run_lab.py writes it to a temporary folder and scans it there. Never deploy it. Files listed under "clean" are safe code: any finding on them (matching rule_hint, or any finding when rule_hint is empty) counts as a false positive.
